name: comp-467
title: Table With Avatars
blurb: Table with avatar images in rows for user/team display.
description: A table variant where one column displays circular avatar images, common for user/contributor lists.
use_when: Showing users, team members, or entities with profile pictures.
avoid_when: Non-user data or when avatars are irrelevant.
a11y: Avatars must have alt text. Ensure table structure is clear.
